description:
Build your Finnish vocabulary, one card at a time. 3000 Finnish Words brings together 3,000 English–Finnish words with illustrated lessons, recorded pronunciation and clear progress tracking.

START FOR FREE
• Practise basic cards and listen to word pronunciation across all 3,000 words.
• Explore 211 complete A-set lessons with illustrations, memory cues and bilingual examples.
• Browse nine YKI-themed topics and smaller everyday word groups, or search and filter your collection.
• Swipe to mark words as Known or Learning, and undo the last swipe.
• Resume your saved study list and follow your progress.

GO FURTHER WITH PREMIUM
An optional one-time Complete unlock opens all 3,000 illustrated lessons, including Finnish examples, English translations, sentence audio and automatic study playback. Premium also includes word reminders with flexible intervals and sleep hours, plus offline downloads for the full collection. No subscription or ads. The price shown in the app comes from your local App Store.

STUDY ONLINE OR OFFLINE
Starter lessons are included. Other pictures and recordings load as you study. The Free A set saves automatically over Wi-Fi or mobile data, with about 32 MB to download beyond the starter media. Premium users can choose whether to save the complete collection, requiring about 430 MB of additional storage. You can keep studying during downloads and manage progress, pause or removal in Settings. iOS manages background download timing. Automatic study playback runs while the app is in the foreground.

MAKE PRACTICE YOUR OWN
Study English-first or Finnish-first, follow your weekly activity, and add your own artwork and memory cues to available lessons. A word can appear in several topics while keeping one shared learning record.

No app account is required. Learning history stays in local app storage. Existing Complete purchasers keep Premium access without buying again. Restore Purchases is in Settings; restoring a purchase does not restore study progress.

3000 Finnish Words is an independent vocabulary learning app. It is not an official YKI examination product and is not affiliated with the exam organiser. Vocabulary practice does not guarantee an exam result.

Questions? Contact support@essaykingapp.com.
notes:
Version 1.1.0 (38) adds topic vocabulary browsing, saved study sessions, a separate Settings tab, automatic Free A-set offline downloads, optional Premium background downloads, flexible Premium reminders and revised Study controls.

No account or sign-in is required. All 3,000 basic word pairs and word pronunciation remain free. The 211 English A-set lessons include complete illustrations, examples and audio. Search apple in Words to open the free omena lesson.

The existing one-time Complete unlock (com.linapps.ykiflashcards.complete) is unchanged. Existing purchasers retain full Premium access without a second purchase. Purchase and Restore Purchases are in Settings. Premium unlocks all complete lessons, full-collection offline downloads, full automatic playback and word reminders. Free users can use automatic study for the A set.

Free media saves automatically over Wi-Fi or cellular data (about 32 MB beyond starter media). Settings > Download for offline study has progress and pause/removal controls. Premium users are offered Wi-Fi, current connection or Later once. Downloads use background URLSession transfers; study remains usable. Word reminders are local notifications with configurable intervals and sleep hours.

Learning history is stored on the device and is separate from purchase restoration. No learning schema, word IDs, app bundle ID or Premium product ID changed. No new app permissions are required for background media transfers.
